Explore actions and command effects

Follow energy, target HP and shield through card actions. Inspect why a play succeeds, stops, or produces a different result in another order.

Research prototype with supplied costs, conditions and modifiers. Card-action sequences support ordinary Active damage. The ordered-command mode supports Active and Passive damage interleaved with bounded state, energy, Block and Heal rows, with no intervening effects; card costs are not applied in that mode. Automatic builds, draws, refunds, X-cost damage scaling and complete card legality are not reconstructed. Results are not gameplay verified.
